Key statistic box

Source: R/crukKeyStatBox.R
crukKeyStatBox.Rd

A bordered box containing a key statement and, optionally, an image. The image sits to the left of the statement when there is room, and above it otherwise.

Usage

crukKeyStatBox(statement, image = NULL)

Arguments

statement

A single character string, or a Shiny output such as shiny::textOutput() or shiny::uiOutput().

image

Optional. File name of an image in the app's www folder, e.g. "magnifying-glass.svg". Displayed at 140px by 140px. Defaults to NULL (no image).

Value

A htmltools::tag object.

Examples

crukKeyStatBox("Nearly 1 in 2 of us will get cancer in our lifetimes.")
#> <div class="cruk-key-stat-box">
#>   <div class="cruk-key-stat-box__box">
#>     <div class="cruk-key-stat-box__statement">Nearly 1 in 2 of us will get cancer in our lifetimes.</div>
#>   </div>
#> </div>
crukKeyStatBox("A statement", image = "magnifying-glass.svg")
#> <div class="cruk-key-stat-box">
#>   <div class="cruk-key-stat-box__box">
#>     <img src="magnifying-glass.svg" alt="" class="cruk-key-stat-box__image"/>
#>     <div class="cruk-key-stat-box__statement">A statement</div>
#>   </div>
#> </div>
